hero.h1: Directive 8020 Controls, QTEs & Turning Points | Settings Guide
hero.intro: Start by separating story replay from mechanical challenge. The official accessibility guide describes them as different groups of options, so choosing Explorer does not by itself define every QTE setting.

sections.heading: Explorer and Survivor are play styles

blocks.text: Explorer lets you revisit decisions with Turning Points while playing. Survivor does not allow those rewinds during the initial story; reach the ending to unlock them. Choose based on whether you want to explore branches immediately or continue with the consequences of your decisions.

The listed difficulty presets are Forgiving, Challenging and Lethal, alongside Custom settings. Review the individual options rather than assuming a preset changes the story’s dialogue or guarantees anyone’s survival.

rows: Uses the same input for QTEs
Solo Story only; a wrong input still fails

Does not make dialogue choices for you

Consult its meaning in your version

sections.heading: Make the interface easier to read

blocks.text: The official options include subtitles, closed captions, text sizing for choices and messages, a simplified font and control remapping. Try readability and input settings before a tense scene so you can tell whether the issue is legibility, timing or the chosen binding.

items: Select your preferred story play style.

Practise the displayed actions before relying on a scene-specific guide.
